title: Practice Bot by Cactuux
description: This datapack/mod lets you practice against practice bots. Requires Carpet Mod
body:
**PRACTICE BOT**

This datapack allows you to practice your mace/crystal pvp against a carpet bot without the need of a bunch of command blocks. 

How To Use

**/function practicebot:macebot (Datapack)**                                              
**/practicebot mace (Mod)**                                                                 
summons mace bot

**/function practicebot:crystalbot (Datapack)**  
**/practicebot crystal (Mod)**                                                              
summons crystal bot                                

Both functions need to be run twice to work. 


**DEPENDENCIES**

Carpet Mod
